blockers.title: "Riprova l'invio" writes the old refused data over later edits of the same row, and brings back rows deleted since; both changes then upload
blockers.evidence: uploadRefusals.ts replays a refused PUT as INSERT OR REPLACE of refusal.data and a refused PATCH as UPDATE of refusal.data, never comparing with the row now and replaying a PUT even after the row was deleted. A PATCH sent after its PUT was refused never becomes a refusal: on the development server a PATCH of a row it does not hold answers 204, so the connector counts it as sent. Browser runs (fake backend, Pixel 7): R1, Eva's insert refused, age edited 15->16 (PATCH accepted), Riprova: '15 anni · dichiarata' and the last upload a POST with the old data. R2, Eva's insert refused, Eva deleted, Riprova: Eva back in Allievi and uploaded.

blockers.title: Rows that share a key-based id settle on whichever phone uploads last, not on the latest edit, and the app says nothing
blockers.evidence: With natural-key ids both phones write the same server row; the connector upserts every PUT and deletes every DELETE by id with no updatedAt comparison, and the readers can only choose between different rows. Live check: B's later '++' (10:00) upserted first, then A's '+' (09:00): the server keeps '+'. Unit run with a server that applies deletes: (a) evaluation saved on two phones, B first: both read '+', no conflict; (b) A's earlier DELETE of a crew member removes B's later row: both phones end with land [student-1], crew-1 empty, resolvedConflicts 0. Seeded fuzz (seed 360423565, 200 rounds): 42 rounds end not on the latest edit. placementConvergence's sync() ignores DELETEs and uploads the later phone last.

blockers.title: The server merges a PUT into an existing row instead of replacing it, so two phones' placements end as a row neither wrote
blockers.evidence: PowerSync's PUT carries only non-null columns; supabase-js upsert sends the keys given, so a column one phone left empty keeps the other phone's value. Live: A at 09:00 saves evaluation '+' with a note; B at 10:00 saves '++' with no note; uploaded A then B: the server holds '++', note 'nota sintetica A', updatedAt 10:00. 22 of the 42 wrong fuzz rounds are this kind.
blockers.reproduction: Reviewer scratch live2.mjs (synthetic course, deleted after).

importantFindings.title: A batch holding one row id twice is answered 500/21000 and retried forever, holding every later change back with no refusal shown
importantFindings.evidence: uploadRuns puts consecutive PUTs of one table into one upsert; two PUTs of one id (e.g. two refusals of one row sent again) get 500 code 21000 ('ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE command cannot affect row a second time', live). The policy retries it, so the per-row fallback is never reached. Browser run R3: a student added afterwards never uploaded in 45 s; status 'Verifica della copia online…'.

importantFindings.title: An edit to a row the server no longer holds is dropped with no refusal and no notice
importantFindings.evidence: A PATCH or DELETE that matches no server row answers 204 (live); the connector completes the transaction. Phone A deletes a student, phone B edits the note offline: B's PATCH changes nothing and the download removes the student from B. Same for a PATCH sent after its PUT was refused.
importantFindings.reproduction: Reviewer scratch live.mjs; connector.ts upload path.

importantFindings.title: The convergence tests' server never applies deletes and always uploads the later phone last
importantFindings.evidence: placementConvergence.test.ts sync() copies rows in uploadOrder; a DELETE never removes the other phone's row and the default order puts the later edit last; SC-B4-2 and -3 pass through unseen.

qolFindings.title: A failure the policy does not recognise is retried forever and shown only as 'Verifica della copia online…' or 'da inviare'
qolFindings.evidence: uploadPolicy.ts: unknown codes and statuses retry; the status line never says uploads are stuck.

qolFindings.title: Only PUTs are batched: a flood of offline PATCHes still goes one request each
qolFindings.evidence: uploadRuns batches only PUT; most saves after days offline are PATCHes (SC-B1-Q3).
